A1_normalization_equivalent_allowed_fiel.root_cause: detect_leakage uses set(map(_normalized, value)) for the public-projection key set, which discards multiplicity, and scan()'s recursive allowlist checks only the normalized spelling, so a second normalization-equivalent alias of an allowed field is admitted alongside the legitimate key.
A1_normalization_equivalent_allowed_fiel.required_fix_direction: reject a public-projection key set whose normalized cardinality exceeds the raw cardinality, and admit at most one normalization-equivalent spelling per allowed field.

A2_nfkc_invisible_confusable_leak_token.root_cause: value scanning is normalization-based, not confusable-based, so leak tokens written with NFKC-invisible homoglyphs are not matched by _LEAK_REGEX.
narrowly_not_claimed: U+FF39 '9' (NFKC-invisible to letters and not a leak token)
A2_nfkc_invisible_confusable_leak_token.required_fix_direction: confusable-aware token matching, or an explicit declaration that NFKC-invisible homoglyph confusables are out of gate scope with a typed reasoning.

A3_malformed_signature_object_untyped.root_cause: require_second_signature dereferences primary_sig.signer_person_id / second_sig.signer_person_id before any isinstance check.
A3_malformed_signature_object_untyped.observed: AttributeError instead of SignatureError; only None is typed ('both signatures required')
A3_malformed_signature_object_untyped.required_fix_direction: isinstance(sig, MockSignature) guard before any attribute access.

A4_non_enum_role_string_untyped.root_cause: require_second_signature re-derives MockSigner(sig.signer_person_id, sig.role).sign(...) and sig.role is used as a Role enum (.value) without validation.

A5_unblind_unhashable_holder_untyped.root_cause: EscrowState.unblind passes holder_person_id straight into holder_roles.get(...).
A5_unblind_unhashable_holder_untyped.observed: TypeError: unhashable type; scalar holders are correctly typed
A5_unblind_unhashable_holder_untyped.required_fix_direction: type-check holder identity before dict access.

A6_capsule_identity_field_types_unvalida.root_cause: commit and capsule_envelope_commitment perform no type validation of any capsule field; the commitment is computed through json.dumps(..., default=str), which silently coerces.
A6_capsule_identity_field_types_unvalida.required_fix_direction: validate identity/purpose/digest/version/freeze/coder/split field types at commit, before the commitment is derived.

regression_bank.purpose: Each must_fail_typed / must_be_refused / must_be_flagged case is the exact regression bank for OC4's repair. They are RED now and must become PASS without weakening any control in the next section.

boundary_observation_not_a_red.observation: the holder-grant registry is a mutable precondition registry outside the event seal; substituting holder_roles['runner1'] is not detected by verify_ledger_integrity
boundary_observation_not_a_red.boundary: the substitute still fails unblind with IdentityMismatchError, and authorize_holder refuses a non-CUSTODIAN role with ConflictError

gate.next_step: author-side repair of A1-A6 followed by re-running this exact court
